review_basis: 23Q4 HDB describes a new one-story house of worship at 773 Neptune and marks nonresidential use despite copying 189 Class A units. The separate residential job B00646589 has another BIN and lot. The later DOB initial record identifies the institutional job as a school with zero dwellings. Keep its HDB count as source evidence and omit this institutional filing from the residential constituent total.

23Q4 HDB records a withdrawn 158-unit proposal at 504 West 49 on July 29 2021 and one permitted 158-unit proposal at 509 West 48 on August 31, with the same lot and mixed-use description. The March 2022 HPD EAS identifies one western housing building and retained eastern open space. Treat the withdrawn proposal as an earlier alternative within this parent; differing BIN and address require this documented decision. Retain HDB 158; the EAS unit forecast is comparison evidence. Withdrawal date is not inferred.
